trash_auto_purge_note: Items in the trash are permanently deleted after 30 days.
type_labels_collision_error: Two content types would end up with the same URL — no changes were saved for content type names. Please use a different name for each.
type_labels_help: Give your articles, pages or projects a different name — useful for a recipe or events site, for example.
type_labels_url_warning: Renaming a type also changes its public URL immediately (e.g. /project/ becomes /recipe/). Existing links and search engine indexing for the old URL are not redirected automatically.
unpublish_confirm: Unpublish this item? It will go back to draft and no longer be publicly visible.
update_apply_confirm: This will replace all core CMS files with the new version. Two backups are created first: your content/settings, and the program files being replaced.
update_failed_apply: Update partially failed. Check file permissions.
update_failed_download: Failed to download the update package. Check your server's internet access.
update_failed_extract: Failed to extract the update package.
update_failed_invalid: The downloaded package is not a valid Synaptik CMS release.
update_failed_no_ziparchive: Auto-update requires the PHP ZipArchive extension, which is not available on this server.
update_failed_safety: Failed to create a safety backup. Update aborted.
update_no_zip: Auto-update is unavailable: the update package URL is not a direct ZIP download. Download and install the update manually.
update_success: Update applied successfully. A safety backup of the previous version was saved in /bckps/.
update_up_to_date: Your CMS is up to date.
update_warning: All core CMS files will be replaced. Your content, settings and uploaded files will not be affected. Two backups are created automatically before the update: one for your content and settings, one for the program files, so both can be restored manually if needed.
upload_err_cant_write: Failed to write file to disk
upload_err_form_size: File exceeds MAX_FILE_SIZE directive in form
upload_err_ini_size: File exceeds upload_max_filesize directive in php.ini
use_custom_menu_help: Check to use the custom menu. If unchecked, the automatic default menu will be used.
users_cannot_change_own_role: You can't change your own role.
users_cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
users_delete_last_admin: Cannot delete the last remaining admin.
users_new_password: New password (leave blank to keep current)
users_update_failed: Could not update this user — username or email may already be in use, or this would leave the site with no admin.
content_type_slug_confusable: This identifier is too close to an existing one (singular/plural of each other).
content_type_builtin_unrenamable: Built-in content types cannot be renamed.
content_type_rename_dir_exists: A data folder with this identifier already exists.
content_type_rename_help: Renaming the identifier moves the type's data folder and updates menus, custom fields and related items. URLs do not change.
content_type_name_help: Leave the plural empty if it is the same as the name. URLs are generated from the names.
